meaning.short_meaning: Lord of Badrinath; a name of Vishnu
meaning.long_meaning: Badrinath corresponds to the Sanskrit form बद्रीनाथ. Its core lexical sense is lord of badrinath; a name of vishnu. बद्रीनाथ (badrinatha) is a name of Vishnu as lord of Badrinath; badri is the jujube tree and natha means lord. The source gloss is essentially correct.
